text:
alex chen: quick heads-up — PR #21784 (argon-cache-ttl) is green everywhere except mac-e2e, which is stuck on a flaky `setup-spec` test. hoping to land before Friday's deploy blackout; can we coordinate a rebase window or a safe fallback?
samir: do we know if the mac failure is deterministic? any stack traces?
alex chen: looks flaky — fails ~30% locally. excerpt from CI log: ```[mac-e2e] ERROR setup-spec.js: timed out waiting for element '#credentials' after 12000ms
Stack: Error: wait timeout
 at Context.<anonymous> (tests/setup-spec.js:42:15)```
ci-bot: mac-e2e: job queued (retry 1/3) — ETA ~18m.
lina: I can take a quick rebase and push a patch to reduce test surface at 09:30 PT. if someone can give a quick +1 on non-mac changes that'd help. @ben? :pray:
ben: can look in 20m. code looks small from diff, but will skim for API changes. if it's only a flaky test and rest green, i'm fine with landing after rebase and a successful mac retry.
alex chen: thanks — plan: lina rebases + pushes, CI retriggers. if mac still flakes after 2 retries, we gate on the Friday blackout and hold until Monday unless a second reviewer is comfortable with canary-only rollout. leaving a manual canary kill-switch in deployment.
samir: pinging release ops — are we okay with a canary-only rollback plan during blackout? we should avoid full rollout.
ben: agree with canary-only; also suggest adding an inline skip to the flaky selector with a TODO to re-enable once we root-cause. small comment in the PR would suffice.
lina: pushed rebase at 1789456342; CI started. mac-e2e queued.
ci-bot: mac-e2e: retry 2/3 started.
alex chen: appreciated — tagging @release-ops for eyes if mac still fails after retry 2. if green, let's merge and monitor canary for 30m. :thumbsup:
samir: noted, will standby for rollback hook.
ci-bot: mac-e2e: retry 2/3 failed (same timeout) — retrying 3/3.
ben: given repeated mac flake, i'm okay with merging with reviewer approval and canary-only rollout + rollback plan. leaving +1 on the PR now.
alex chen: ben +1 noted. merging after final mac retry completes; if retry 3 fails we'll still proceed per plan. thanks everyone. :rocket:
